definitionValue: fun s N => ∑ j ∈ Finset.Icc 1 N, 1 / ↑j ^ s
fun n s W => ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), ZetaNine.CoefficientMapJet.weightedLocalCoefficient n j s W

fun n W =>
  -∑ j ∈ Finset.range (n + 1),
      ∑ s ∈ Finset.Icc 1 9,
        ZetaNine.CoefficientMapJet.weightedLocalCoefficient n j s W * ZetaNine.HarmonicStability.harmonicPower s j
fun n T W => ∑ t ∈ Finset.Icc 1 T, ZetaNine.CoefficientMap.weightedR n W ↑t

fun n T W =>
  ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (n + 1),
    ∑ s ∈ Finset.Icc 1 9,
      ZetaNine.CoefficientMapJet.weightedLocalCoefficient n j s W *
        (ZetaNine.HarmonicStability.harmonicPower s (T + j) - ZetaNine.HarmonicStability.harmonicPower s T)

type:
∀ (s T : ℕ),
  ZetaNine.HarmonicStability.harmonicPower s (T + 1) = ZetaNine.HarmonicStability.harmonicPower s T + 1 / ↑(T + 1) ^ s

∀ (s T j : ℕ),
  ∑ t ∈ Finset.Icc 1 T, 1 / (↑t + ↑j) ^ s =
    ZetaNine.HarmonicStability.harmonicPower s (T + j) - ZetaNine.HarmonicStability.harmonicPower s j

∀ (n T : ℕ) (W : ℚ[X]),
  ZetaNine.CoefficientMapInjectivity.ProperMultiplier n W →
    ZetaNine.CoefficientMapFiniteSum.finiteL n T W =
      ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (n + 1),
        ∑ s ∈ Finset.Icc 1 9,
          ZetaNine.CoefficientMapJet.weightedLocalCoefficient n j s W *
            (ZetaNine.HarmonicStability.harmonicPower s (T + j) - ZetaNine.HarmonicStability.harmonicPower s j)

∀ (n T : ℕ) (W : ℚ[X]),
  ZetaNine.CoefficientMapInjectivity.ProperMultiplier n W →
    ZetaNine.CoefficientMapFiniteSum.finiteL n T W =
      ZetaNine.CoefficientMapFiniteSum.constantTerm n W +
          ∑ s ∈ Finset.Icc 1 9,
            ZetaNine.CoefficientMapFiniteSum.rho n s W * ZetaNine.HarmonicStability.harmonicPower s T +
        ZetaNine.CoefficientMapFiniteSum.shiftedTail n T W

∀ (n T : ℕ) (W : ℚ[X]),
  ZetaNine.CoefficientMapInjectivity.ProperMultiplier n W →
    ZetaNine.CoefficientMapFiniteSum.rho n 1 W = 0 →
      ZetaNine.CoefficientMapFiniteSum.finiteL n T W =
        ZetaNine.CoefficientMapFiniteSum.constantTerm n W +
            ∑ s ∈ Finset.Icc 2 9,
              ZetaNine.CoefficientMapFiniteSum.rho n s W * ZetaNine.HarmonicStability.harmonicPower s T +
          ZetaNine.CoefficientMapFiniteSum.shiftedTail n T W

∀ (n T : ℕ) (W : ℚ[X]),
  ZetaNine.CoefficientMapInjectivity.ProperMultiplier n W →
    ZetaNine.CoefficientMapFiniteSum.rho n 1 W = 0 →
      ZetaNine.CoefficientMapFiniteSum.rho n 2 W = 0 →
        ZetaNine.CoefficientMapFiniteSum.rho n 4 W = 0 →
          ZetaNine.CoefficientMapFiniteSum.rho n 6 W = 0 →
            ZetaNine.CoefficientMapFiniteSum.rho n 8 W = 0 →
              ZetaNine.CoefficientMapFiniteSum.finiteL n T W =
                ZetaNine.CoefficientMapFiniteSum.constantTerm n W +
                    (ZetaNine.CoefficientMapFiniteSum.rho n 3 W * ZetaNine.HarmonicStability.harmonicPower 3 T +
                          ZetaNine.CoefficientMapFiniteSum.rho n 5 W * ZetaNine.HarmonicStability.harmonicPower 5 T +
                        ZetaNine.CoefficientMapFiniteSum.rho n 7 W * ZetaNine.HarmonicStability.harmonicPower 7 T +
                      ZetaNine.CoefficientMapFiniteSum.rho n 9 W * ZetaNine.HarmonicStability.harmonicPower 9 T) +
                  ZetaNine.CoefficientMapFiniteSum.shiftedTail n T W

∀ (s T j : ℕ),
  ZetaNine.HarmonicStability.harmonicPower s (T + j) - ZetaNine.HarmonicStability.harmonicPower s T =
    ∑ k ∈ Finset.Icc 1 j, 1 / (↑T + ↑k) ^ s

∀ (n T : ℕ) (f : ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → ℚ),
  ∑ t ∈ Finset.Icc 1 T, ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), ∑ s ∈ Finset.Icc 1 9, f t j s =
    ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), ∑ s ∈ Finset.Icc 1 9, ∑ t ∈ Finset.Icc 1 T, f t j s

∀ (n T : ℕ) (W : ℚ[X]),
  2 * n + 2 * W.natDegree < 9 * (n + 1) →
    ∑ t ∈ Finset.Icc 1 T, ZetaNine.CoefficientMap.weightedR n W ↑t =
      ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (n + 1),
        ∑ s ∈ Finset.Icc 1 9,
          ZetaNine.CoefficientMapJet.weightedLocalCoefficient n j s W *
            (ZetaNine.HarmonicStability.harmonicPower s (T + j) - ZetaNine.HarmonicStability.harmonicPower s j)

∀ (n T : ℕ) (W : ℚ[X]),
  2 * n + 2 * W.natDegree < 9 * (n + 1) →
    ZetaNine.CoefficientMapFiniteSum.finiteL n T W =
      ZetaNine.CoefficientMapFiniteSum.constantTerm n W +
          ∑ s ∈ Finset.Icc 1 9,
            ZetaNine.CoefficientMapFiniteSum.rho n s W * ZetaNine.HarmonicStability.harmonicPower s T +
        ZetaNine.CoefficientMapFiniteSum.shiftedTail n T W

∀ (n T : ℕ) (W : ℚ[X]),
  2 * n + 2 * W.natDegree < 9 * (n + 1) →
    ZetaNine.CoefficientMapFiniteSum.rho n 1 W = 0 →
      ZetaNine.CoefficientMapFiniteSum.finiteL n T W =
        ZetaNine.CoefficientMapFiniteSum.constantTerm n W +
            ∑ s ∈ Finset.Icc 2 9,
              ZetaNine.CoefficientMapFiniteSum.rho n s W * ZetaNine.HarmonicStability.harmonicPower s T +
          ZetaNine.CoefficientMapFiniteSum.shiftedTail n T W

∀ (n T : ℕ) (W : ℚ[X]),
  2 * n + 2 * W.natDegree < 9 * (n + 1) →
    ZetaNine.CoefficientMapFiniteSum.rho n 1 W = 0 →
      ZetaNine.CoefficientMapFiniteSum.rho n 2 W = 0 →
        ZetaNine.CoefficientMapFiniteSum.rho n 4 W = 0 →
          ZetaNine.CoefficientMapFiniteSum.rho n 6 W = 0 →
            ZetaNine.CoefficientMapFiniteSum.rho n 8 W = 0 →
              ZetaNine.CoefficientMapFiniteSum.finiteL n T W =
                ZetaNine.CoefficientMapFiniteSum.constantTerm n W +
                    (ZetaNine.CoefficientMapFiniteSum.rho n 3 W * ZetaNine.HarmonicStability.harmonicPower 3 T +
                          ZetaNine.CoefficientMapFiniteSum.rho n 5 W * ZetaNine.HarmonicStability.harmonicPower 5 T +
                        ZetaNine.CoefficientMapFiniteSum.rho n 7 W * ZetaNine.HarmonicStability.harmonicPower 7 T +
                      ZetaNine.CoefficientMapFiniteSum.rho n 9 W * ZetaNine.HarmonicStability.harmonicPower 9 T) +
                  ZetaNine.CoefficientMapFiniteSum.shiftedTail n T W

∀ (s j : ℕ),
  ∑ t ∈ Finset.Icc 1 0, 1 / (↑t + ↑j) ^ s =
    ZetaNine.HarmonicStability.harmonicPower s (0 + j) - ZetaNine.HarmonicStability.harmonicPower s j
∀ (s T : ℕ), ∑ t ∈ Finset.Icc 1 T, 1 / ↑t ^ s = ZetaNine.HarmonicStability.harmonicPower s T

∀ (T j : ℕ),
  ∑ t ∈ Finset.Icc 1 T, 1 / (↑t + ↑j) ^ 0 =
    ZetaNine.HarmonicStability.harmonicPower 0 (T + j) - ZetaNine.HarmonicStability.harmonicPower 0 j

∀ (s T j : ℕ),
  ZetaNine.HarmonicStability.harmonicPower s (T + j) - ZetaNine.HarmonicStability.harmonicPower s T =
    ∑ k ∈ Finset.Icc 1 j, 1 / (↑T + ↑k) ^ s

∀ (n : ℕ) (W : ℚ[X]),
  ZetaNine.CoefficientMapFiniteSum.shiftedTail n 0 W = -ZetaNine.CoefficientMapFiniteSum.constantTerm n W

ZetaNine.CoefficientMapFiniteSum.constantTerm 0 (Polynomial.X ^ 4) +
      ∑ s ∈ Finset.Icc 2 9,
        ZetaNine.CoefficientMapFiniteSum.rho 0 s (Polynomial.X ^ 4) * ZetaNine.HarmonicStability.harmonicPower s 1 +
    ZetaNine.CoefficientMapFiniteSum.shiftedTail 0 1 (Polynomial.X ^ 4) =
  0

ZetaNine.CoefficientMapFiniteSum.finiteL 0 1 (Polynomial.X ^ 4) ≠
  ZetaNine.CoefficientMapFiniteSum.constantTerm 0 (Polynomial.X ^ 4) +
      ∑ s ∈ Finset.Icc 2 9,
        ZetaNine.CoefficientMapFiniteSum.rho 0 s (Polynomial.X ^ 4) * ZetaNine.HarmonicStability.harmonicPower s 1 +
    ZetaNine.CoefficientMapFiniteSum.shiftedTail 0 1 (Polynomial.X ^ 4)
